summary.text: Thom Tillis is the U.S. Senator from North Carolina, elected in 2014.

paragraphs.text: He worked for 29 years in the private sector in technology and management consulting, including as an executive at PricewaterhouseCoopers and IBM, and earned his degree at age 36.
He served on the Cornelius Board of Commissioners and was elected to the North Carolina House of Representatives in 2006, serving as Speaker from 2011 to 2014.
He lives in Huntersville, North Carolina, with his wife Susan.
